items.title: "환자 눈 보는 동안 기록은 AI가"…33년차 외과의가 만든 '왕진 도구'
items.excerpt: 왕진연구소(집으로의원) 김주형 대표가 방문진료 중 대화를 SOAP 형식 기록 초안으로 정리하는 AI 기능을 개발했다. TV·보호자 소리가 섞이는 가정 환경을 고려했으며, 회사 자체 측정에서 주 50건 왕진 의사의 행정 시간이 주 12.5시간에서 1.7시간으로 줄었다.

items.title: "이 일을 언제까지 할 수 있을까"…소아응급 전문의가 AI 개발한 이유
items.excerpt: 삼성서울병원 응급의학과 손명희 교수가 소아응급 인력난에 대비해 의료진을 만나기 전 보호자에게 먼저 묻고 소통 공백을 줄이는 소아응급 커뮤니케이션 AI 에이전트와 검증 체계를 개발한 사례를 HiPex 2026에서 발표했다.

items.title: AI improves trainee doctors' ear disease diagnostic accuracy by 32.2 percentage points: AMC
items.excerpt: Asan Medical Center built an AI model on 7,335 ear endoscopy images and tested it with 13 physicians; with AI assistance junior trainees' accuracy at telling chronic otitis media from otitis media with effusion rose from 54.4% to 86.6%, shrinking the gap with faculty from 24.3 to 3.1 points. (Off-list outlet; no on-list Korean version in feeds.)

items.title: 루닛, 의료 특화 AI 파운데이션 모델 '러닝유닛 2.0' 전격 공개
items.excerpt: 루닛이 정부 '의과학 특화 파운데이션 모델' 과제로 병원 내부 구동형 300억(활성 50억) 파라미터 에이전트 모델 '러닝유닛 2.0'을 허깅페이스에 오픈소스로 공개했다. 일산병원·건양대병원·고려대의료원 등 9개 기관 실증에서 다학제 진료 방침의 86.2%가 임상적으로 타당하다는 평가를 받았고 KTAS 분류·약물이상반응 판정도 시험했다.

items.title: 대구가톨릭대의료원, 미숙아 만성 폐질환 예측 AI 모델 개발
items.excerpt: 대구가톨릭대의료원 연구팀이 신생아중환자실 미숙아 2,153명 데이터로 기관지폐이형성증 위험을 생후 7일간 단계별로 예측하는 머신러닝 모델을 개발했다. AUC는 출생 직후 0.751에서 생후 7일 정보 종합 시 0.923까지 올랐다(Children 게재).

items.title: 엑스레이도 '공간 맞춤형' 시대…삼성전자, AI 장착한 천장형 'GC85A Fit' 출격
items.excerpt: 삼성전자 의료기기사업부가 플래그십 영상처리 엔진과 AI 솔루션을 유지한 모듈형 천장형 디지털 엑스레이 'GC85A Fit'을 내놨다. 검사실 밖에서 환자 자세를 보고 원격 조정하는 '비전 어시스트' 등 재촬영을 줄이는 기능을 담았다. (제품 출시 기사 — AI는 부가 기능, 약한 후보.)

items.title: How early efforts to build autonomous clinical AI tools are approaching regulation
items.excerpt: Multiple teams in ARPA-H's ADVOCATE program, which funds autonomous clinical AI agents, have already held initial informational meetings with the FDA less than two months after the program launched. (Registration wall; body partial.)

items.title: Hospitals write off $132B as AI fails to move the needle with finances
items.excerpt: Hospitals are losing more money from bad debt and write-offs despite investing billions into automation and AI to improve revenue-cycle performance, a new analysis finds.

items.title: AI beats scientists at finding errors in clinical research papers
items.excerpt: New findings demonstrate AI's aptitude for identifying technical flaws in clinical studies where medical decisions are on the line, outperforming human scientists. (Page Cloudflare-gated; date from Crossref created, image from RSS enclosure.)

items.title: AI chatbots aren't therapists. But can they finally get men to open up?
items.excerpt: AI chatbots are imperfect therapists, but STAT examines whether they can lower barriers that keep men from seeking mental health care.

items.title: Why the latest heart drug failures should make us all more skeptical of AI hype
items.excerpt: Once again, a hot new technology that was supposed to speed up drug research has fallen flat: AHA 2026 heart-drug failures as a lesson for AI-driven drug development. (STAT+ analysis.)

items.title: Lunit to supply AI software to Saudi National Guard health system
items.excerpt: Lunit will license Lunit Insight CXR and Lunit Insight MMG to Saudi Arabia's Ministry of National Guard Health Affairs, integrating chest x-ray and mammography AI into its existing PACS across hospitals in Riyadh, Jeddah and other cities.

items.title: USARad expands use of AZmed's x-ray AI
items.excerpt: Nanox teleradiology subsidiary USARad is further integrating AZmed's Rayvolve x-ray AI suite, eight FDA-cleared musculoskeletal and chest x-ray applications, into its reading workflows.

items.title: AI-interpreted echocardiograms comparable to human reports, cardiologists' time cut by about 50%
items.excerpt: AHA Scientific Sessions 2026: in a study testing an AI model for evaluating echocardiograms, AI-assisted interpretation was comparable to standard human reports and cut cardiologists' reading time by about half. (Off-list newsroom.heart.org; cardiology imaging saturated — accept only as a distinct result.)

items.title: Randomized Evaluation of an Autoimmune Disease Prediction Model — AURA (AUtoimmune Risk Assessment)
items.excerpt: NEJM AI original article reporting a randomized evaluation of AURA, an autoimmune disease risk-prediction model. (Page Cloudflare-gated; date from Crossref created.)

items.title: AI-enabled virtual mental health startup Siggy launches from stealth
items.excerpt: Siggy, an AI-enabled virtual mental health provider combining therapy, prescription management and AI tools, launched from stealth with $6 million in pre-seed funding. (Launch + funding; weak.)

items.title: Doximity expands clinical AI footprint to more than 190 health systems
items.excerpt: More than 190 health systems have now purchased Doximity's clinical AI suite, up from 165, as the company expands enterprise deployments of its AI tools for clinicians.

items.title: LLM ensemble PREVIA predicts future PTSD risk from emergency department trauma narratives with expert-level accuracy
items.excerpt: NYU Langone's open-source LLM ensemble PREVIA predicts one-month PTSD risk from ED patients' answer to a single routine-care question ('What brought you to the ED?'); on 30 patients who developed PTSD it flagged all, versus 89% for a PTSD-specialist clinician.

items.title: MambaSleepCVD for prediction of long term cardiovascular outcomes from polysomnography
items.excerpt: A deep-learning model on full-night polysomnography signals estimates how much prognostic information sleep studies carry for long-term cardiovascular disease risk.

items.title: The Big Challenge for AI in Healthcare Comes After Approval
items.excerpt: Opinion: healthcare AI changes after initial clearance, often unexpectedly, so postmarket monitoring and change control are the real regulatory challenge. (Opinion; weak.)
